subject: PrivDeploy: Platform fee vs node credits — reconciliation and next steps
messages:
From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novaforge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Katrina Li <katrina@novaforge.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial — platform fee vs node credits question

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement dug into the draft commercial and we need a clearer write-up of two things before we move to legal:

1) How the platform fee is amortized across a 36-month pilot -> production path, and what portion (if any) can be translated into node credits (we operate across two US sites, ~40 inference GPUs equivalent today).
2) Exit protection / migration credit language — if we decide to move off after year 2, what credits apply and how are unamortized platform fees handled?

Our internal ask: give us 2 alternative pricing constructs: (A) reduce platform fee by 60% and increase node credits; (B) keep platform fee but provide a staggered migration credit schedule tied to committed months. We can share our forecast numbers if that helps.

Attached: procurement_checklist.xlsx (for your reference). Looking to close commercial by the end of the month.

Thanks,
Amit

--

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PrivDeploy commercial — platform fee vs node credits question

Folks — I reviewed Amit's usage profile and sketched three scenarios in the attached workbook:

- Option 1 (Baseline): Platform fee amortized equally over 36 months; separate node credits for burst capacity.
- Option 2 (Hybrid): Reduce platform fee by 50% year-1, convert 30% of platform fee to node credits (applied as a pre-funded pool usable across sites), 12-month step-down migration credit if terminated early.
- Option 3 (Node-forward): Minimal platform fee, larger node credit allocation, but higher per-node unit price after 24 months.

Key open items for legal/procurement:
- Definition of "unamortized platform fee" and how credits are applied (cash offset vs invoice credit).
- Whether node credits can be transferred between Novaforge subsidiaries/sites.
- Support tier: does Novaforge want SRE retainer (24/7) or Standard (business hours)? SRE retainer affects amortization scale.

I've attached the workbook: platform-fee-breakdown.xlsx and a draft migration credit table (tab: migration_credit).

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novaforge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: PrivDeploy term sheet + two commercial constructs (for review)

Hi Amit / Katrina — attaching a short term sheet and 2 commercial constructs based on Amit's ask. High level summary below; full math in the workbook.

Option A — Platform-first (lower per-node unit):
- Platform fee: $300k/year amortized monthly over contract term.
- Node credits: 600 node-hours prepaid, transferable across US sites.
- Migration credit: 6 months of platform fee credited if canceled after 24 months.

Option B — Hybrid (customer preferred):
- Platform fee: $150k/year (year 1), 50% reduction year 1 only.
- Node credits: 1,200 node-hours pre-funded pool applied as invoice credit.
- Migration credit: Step schedule: 12 months credit if exit in months 13–24; 6 months credit months 25–36.
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; SRE retainer optional at $12k/month.

Attachments: redwood-privdeploy-term-sheet.docx, Novaforge_SOW_v3.pdf, platform-fee-breakdown.xlsx

Would you be open to a 30-min cadence on Tuesday 10/14 to align on which option to take to legal?

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Commercial Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Katrina Li <katrina@novaforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novaforge.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: PrivDeploy term sheet + two commercial constructs (for review)

Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Procurement + Finance prefer Option B with the following clarifications before legal:

- Migration credit needs to be explicitly cash-offsettable against outstanding invoices (not only future invoices).
- Need guarantee that node credits are transferable between the two US sites and between legal entities under Novaforge.
- Request a limited price-hold: no per-node price increases >5% year-over-year for first 24 months.

Attached: novaforge_procurement_checklist.pdf (internal). Our target: approve commercial terms and hand to legal by 2025-10-20.

One quick Q: what does Redwood consider an "SRE retainer" operationally? Is that a named SRE on call or a shared pager + quarterly reviews?

Thanks — Katrina

--
Katrina Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Novaforge
katrina@novaforge.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Katrina Li <katrina@novaforge.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@novaforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: PrivDeploy term sheet + two commercial constructs (for review)

Katrina / Amit — appreciate the quick turn. We can accept Option B with the three clarifications incorporated. Summary of agreed adjustments and next steps: 

1) Migration credit: we will add language to the term sheet that unamortized platform fees can be applied as cash-offsets against outstanding invoices for up to 12 months post-termination (capped per SOW).
2) Node credit transferability: term sheet will explicitly permit transfer of credits between Novaforge subsidiaries and US sites (requires notification; not permitted to sell or assign to third parties).
3) Price-hold: Redwood commits to <=5% annual per-node price increase for first 24 months.

Support clarification: SRE retainer = named on-call rotation + 1x quarterly architecture review + monthly operational health checks. We will include an SLA table that lists response windows and dedicated escalation path. Retainer option is add-on at $12k/month; we can include a 3-month trial at no charge if legal agrees to standard T&Cs.

Action items:
- Marissa: update term sheet with language above and circulate DocuSign link.
- Irene: prepare final amortization schedule and redline the invoice-credit clause for legal.
- Sean: schedule a 30-min signoff call with Novaforge procurement (suggest 2025-10-20 10:00 PT).

If that looks right I'll have the updated DocuSign out by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Sean
